BL-1392 — The swarm never checks that the cron daemon it schedules into is alive: cron has been stopped on this WSL host since 2026-08-30, so the freshness watchdog, every shift start and bedtime, and the descent review were silently inert while every install printed success
What it solves: `required_wiring` anchors 1 and 2 are consumer anchors: the installer is
what every start runs, the daemon is the only process that can notice a
dead cron; both literals are absent today (grep this pass). The
install-time probe alone would be the BL-1235 shape (green at start,
blind afterwards), wh…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. The host fix is not this ticket and needs root: `sudo service cron start` now, and a `[boot] command="service cron start"` line in /etc/wsl.conf so it survives a WSL restart - see backlog/evi…
